summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field after _get_time; finished property now checks finished_time; Task._reset clears it; Progress.update and advance capture elapsed as last step under the lock when completed >= total and not finished; Progress.reset clears it before refresh); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased, Added: Progress.TimeElapsedColumn); tests/test_progress.py (import, test_time_elapsed_column, column added to test_columns with regenerated expected output derived by hand-tracing clock reads); tests/test_palette.py (new, asserts 16 rows). Expected output for test_columns is hand-derived and unverified because tests were not run. Choices: no max_refresh cap on the new column; RGB cell uses repr of the triplet.
